name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Product Support Specialist
summary: Customer-facing technical support professional with 15+ years troubleshooting SaaS platforms, translating complex issues into clear explanations, and closing the loop between customers and Product/Engineering teams. At Birdeye, guided 15-20 partner accounts through technical setup and configuration while sharing structured, high-priority customer feedback that informed the product roadmap, sustaining roughly 94% retention. At Wix, onboarded 25+ users monthly across a high-volume support and launch workload. Comfortable digging into a reported issue until the real cause surfaces, then explaining it simply to both the customer and the internal team who needs to fix it.
